subject: Candidate delayed at border — propose condensed single-slot interview
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: URGENT: Candidate delayed at border — propose condensed single-slot interview

Hi team,

Quick heads-up: our incoming candidate, Alex Gonzalez (resume attached), is currently stuck at an international customs check and has been delayed by an unpredictable hold at the airport. Alex just emailed to say there is a queue and estimated clearance around 15:20 local time.

We have two realistic options so we don't lose the day and still give Alex a fair shot:

1) Condense the planned 3x30m panel into a single 60–75 minute compact session when Alex clears — coding + focused system-design follow-up. We can record the session for anyone who needs to review afterward.
2) Keep the panels but shift to an asynchronous option: have the coding portion recorded (or Alex records a short live codewalk once they arrive) and the rest by takehome.

Can you reply with availability and preference within the next 25 minutes? If option 1 works, please confirm you can be flexible to start between 15:25–15:45 today. If you prefer option 2, say so and who can own the recorded/code-review follow-up.

Attachment: alex_gonzalez_resume.pdf (PDF)

Thanks — I'll update as soon as I hear from Alex.

— Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Recruiting Lead, Hiring Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: URGENT: Candidate delayed at border — propose condensed single-slot interview

Thanks Sofia — I can do Option 1 (condensed single slot).

If Alex clears around 15:20–15:30 PT, I can compress the coding exercise to ~40 minutes (focus on core prompt + follow-ups) and then spend ~20–30 minutes on system-design highlights. If needed I can also do the system-design portion asynchronously by reviewing a short recording — happy to step in either way.

I don’t think we need the full three interviewers in the room; Marcus + Mina should cover it and record for the rest of the panel.

Quick ask — can we confirm the candidate's phone number so I can call if they clear customs while in transit? Also, should we record the session for the hiring committee? I'm fine with that if everyone agrees.

— Mina

Hi Sofia / Marcus / Mina —

Really sorry for the last-minute stress. I ran into an extended customs queue after a paperwork flag; border agents estimate clearance by 15:20–15:30 PT. I can make a compact format work and I consent to the session being recorded for the interview committee.

My backup plan: if customs finishes earlier I'll try to get to the office by 15:10–15:25 and can do the condensed session in person. If there is any network/proximity issue, I'm happy to do a live remote share for the coding portion and then the design section over a short call.

Phone while traveling: +1 (415) 555-0198
Attachment: alex_passport_scan.jpg (JPEG)

Thanks for being flexible — appreciate the team's willingness to adapt.

— Alex Gonzalez
alex.gonzalez@example.com
